pins: CE3: the arena, a one-way drop with 3 of the air disc, gets back only by the disc teleport, which the escape takes once the boss is down and the slot collected (RANDOMIZER_PLAN §2.9); the nook, whose way back needs the water the vault holds after the disc is whole, is a trap until then, and once the slot is collected the region's three nodes are the traps after completion
